d: What a good photo asks for
An AI that takes steps on your behalf
n: An agent is an AI that takes steps, not just answers: it opens the file, runs the search, drafts the email, moves to the next thing. The difference from a chat window is that steps have consequences. Before you hand an agent a job, write down which steps it may take on its own and which ones wait for you.
